_comment: Running-session variables that every test entry point clears: the node preload (_hermetic-env.mjs), the core-adapter rig (_r46world.ts), tests/_isolation.py, scripts/foreman_test_run.mjs (every command it starts), scripts/replay_run.mjs and the installer preload (tests/installer/_hermetic-env.mjs), the last three through scripts/session_env.mjs. The child git env (GIT_CONFIG_*, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT) is not listed on purpose: it keeps test code a child runs from pushing. Keep PI_FOREMAN_PYTHON out: CI's Windows job sets it from outside. PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR is cleared too; the tests that need it set it themselves.
